definition: to be expected to do something
description: On a sunny rooftop deck, a young man in a white vest and cream shorts lies in a rope hammock with his eyes closed, holding a small brown dog on his chest. Behind him, by the wooden fence, a paint tin stands on a stool, and a young woman in a red zip jacket, white crop top and denim shorts stands with her hands on her hips, frowning down at him. He opens his eyes, grins, and pulls a cap down over his face, and she throws up one hand in frustration. String lights hang above.

taps.phrase: to curl up on his chest
